phase_contract.selection: Implementation phases may be independently parallelized only where their code ownership and state contracts do not conflict; Root owns actual ordering and exact allowed paths
phase_contract.focused_vs_gate: Focused Rust commands are quick developer feedback, not receipts for a registered full check. Required registered check IDs must run their actual commands at frozen slice acceptance. Current component adapter runs its full 100 obligations and fresh SQLite fixtures; no unsupported --focus option is proposed as if already present.
phase_contract.rc_policy: Keep source snapshot and full preimage stable before implementation; freeze package/source/resources for each integrated RC, put actual runs outside planned CSV/OpenSpec input hashes. Native/game passes are not inherited across changed packages.
phase_contract.visual_policy: Any desktop-path product change triggers current visual capture gate; prior design source mismatch remains failed until separately reviewed authority correction. No auto baseline hash refresh/approved PNG replacement/threshold reduction.
phase_contract.quality_policy: Freeze device/load/sample/measurement and thresholds before performance acceptance. Do not invent p95 targets or copy previous optional probes into passed tests.
phase_contract.five_negative_scenarios: 每个集成切片的实际 npm run verify 必须出现 five-scenario-execution passed 回执。它由 verify.py self_tests 自动运行，不是当前 CHECK_IDS 中可直接写进 requirements.checks 的ID；不能为映射方便伪造注册。PRD越界、设计不一致、模块越界、目录越界、未批准框架均保持。
phase_contract.resource_budget: 原有队列/帧/进程/临时文件预算、许可和身份拒绝不放宽。全局内存/SLO缺实际测量时保持未验收，不能通过增加容量消除压力反例。
phase_contract.first_slice_not_ui: SR-1仅WindowPreviewService私有purestate，不提前修改TS/Native/worker。完整100组件义务在SR-2/集成保持；原RBC目的不能被减少。apps/desktop全树visual规则仍适用SR-1纯Rust源。
phase_contract.test_addition_timing: 每个切片迁移时同步补/迁移对应生产共用测试，不等所有文件抽离完才补测试。发现既存行为与合同冲突先单列bugfix，不改断言迁就当前实现。

phases.parallel_rule: 若精确文件Owner不冲突，可与SR-2独立实施；在SR-3集成后必须做订阅+适高+词卡联合回归
phases.closure_rule: 可以做源码开发和聚焦验证，但相关check失败/blocked时不能声明完整切片通过；尤其不删视觉capture或改批准hash来让重构变绿。

phases.title: 单一最终RC稳定性关口
phases.planned_runtime_adapter_requirement: 最小稳定性正式包runner必须真实安装/运行对象核验、可读人工step barrier、原生/游戏证据与源码/包/资源/nonce绑定，实施后独立注册；不能以新名字或手填JSON代替执行。
exit: 所有受影响源码/编译/边界/组件/视觉检查真实执行且通过；原视觉来源失败未解决时不能称本阶段整体passed
同一最终RC四游戏SR/MO/Never7/Sakura 10th（排除Ever17），覆盖真实连续原文、预览变化帧、语言/词卡、退出换游戏、窗口事件与真实sleep/wake；SR中文版不充当日文学习证据
正式包稳定性runner已实现与注册、负例/失败状态可拒绝；真实权限/桌面/Steam阻塞保留blocked，不继承旧包通过
剩余完整首版发布仍需原153 case@variant及RW91适用真实层闭合；稳定性通过不是剩余功能已完成或正式发布批准
phases.release_scope_limit: 可以在此后恢复剩余产品功能开发；正式发布仍要完整范围与153/RW闭包，不把这些全量要求提前压到SR-0第一个小切片。

failure_rules.action: Stop affected slice; fix production problem or truthful harness wiring, preserve old failure; never delete assertions, widen wait/budget, or tune expected outputs to implementation
Keep visual failed and preserve original references; independent authority review is a separate prerequisite, not a blanket waiver for refactoring
Record blocked/not_run; continue independent source work but do not close packaged stability acceptance
Reject evidence freshness; rerun only affected execution after new frozen source/package, do not rewrite JSON to attach old results
Mark proposed/not_implemented; implementation and actual registered execution required before claiming machine enforcement

evidence_contract.cardinality_rule: Every required obligation exactly once in the claimed scope; zero tests/skips/stale source/wrong RC/empty adapter cannot pass
evidence_contract.privacy_rule: No credential values, raw diagnostic dumps, or unrelated window capture; safe stage/reason/code counts sufficient

evidence.note: registered source checks and empty runtime registry
real component adapter and independently required case IDs
current supervisor frame and lifecycle tests

limitations: 本子任务未执行任何新产品、fixture、GUI、Wine、安装或长测试
建议文件/adapter仍须Root纳入OpenSpec精确scope及独立审阅后实现，不能视为已存在
计划阶段的pass只可表示文档/引用校验通过，不能表示产品测试通过
本计划不补参数、回退、OCR或新UI功能，不改原PRD与批准视觉
